note:
A4 R3: does the post-spike current pulse explain the missing somatic residual depolarisation? (protocol diagnosis only)
Copy of glusynapse_v2/rho_redesign/basics/bio/V3/resdep_cell.py (single post cell, no synapses / minis / network; loaded as
runsinglecell / prefire do: CircuitSimulation(prefire_simulation_config.json of the pair) with the GluSynapse condition
stripped). Only the pulse conditions changed:
  A_find3     3 ms pulses at the pair's own found amplitude = amp_start of pulse0 in that emodel's
              sjostrom_<f>hz_dt+10ms/prefire_simulation_config.json (the pipeline stimulus, per frequency)
  B_5ms_<I>   5 ms pulses at I = 0.8 / 1.2 / 1.5 nA (Sjostrom 2001 Methods: 5 ms, 0.8-1.5 nA per spike; A5 ANCHORS R1 Q1 row 6)
5 pulses at 10 / 20 / 40 / 50 Hz, starting at 500 ms.
SK_E2: old emodel (s2g0321) runs had no_SK_E2 + soma/axon uninsert (fixhp default) -> same here; the hfih03dt runs were made
with KEEP_SK=1 (config modifications [], SK kept) -> SK kept here.
Measures (resdep_diag.measure, unchanged): base = mean Vm 10 ms before the first pulse;
  rd_spike = mean over k=2..5 of (mean Vm in the 1 ms before AP_k) - base   (Sjostrom 2001 definition, A5 R1 Q1 row 1;
             with a current pulse the AP comes 3-5 ms after pulse onset, so this window lies inside the pulse's own charging)
  rd_onset = same with the 1 ms before pulse onset k (free of the pulse's own charge; the comparable number)
  trough   = mean over k=1..4 of min Vm from AP_k + 2 ms to the next onset - base
  n_ap per pulse (crossings of -20 mV in [onset, onset + ISI)); doublets (>= 2) are one firing but are reported.
Targets (soma): Sjostrom 2001 Fig 5D 0 / 4.9 / 8.3 / 12.0 mV at 10/20/40/50 Hz. Pipeline sims (prefire, soma, via SPEC.md):
